data.text: Good, I can see the structure. Now I'll run a query to get monthly revenue for January-August 2018, filtering out canceled and unavailable orders.

args.purpose: Monthly revenue from January to August 2018, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
  strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') as month,
  SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y') = '2018'
  AND extract(month FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
GROUP BY strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month
